scope: Merge of branch minimal-form-single-package into master (merge commit bd2a74f), shipping four things. (1) Pre-payment form reduced to groom_name, bride_name, email and phone only; date, style, format, outfit, idea and photo upload all moved to a post-payment brief on thank-you.html. (2) VIP package (₪870) removed; single package 'הסרטון שלכם' at ₪450, 10-15 seconds; carousel package-toggle removed and Ran & Eden is now the first slide; terms.html revisions clause rewritten for one package. (3) Customer identity (order number, names, email, phone, package) is now attached to the post-payment brief submission via an sd_customer_identity localStorage mirror written at page load, so a paid order can always be identified even if the Grow redirect drops paid=1. (4) Three QA-found defects fixed: Israeli mobile phone validation added to the submit handler with a Hebrew error that blocks the redirect and normalizes the stored value to bare digits; anonymous brief subjects made collision-proof with seconds plus a 4-char random token; the Lead pixel moved out of the thank-you head snippet into order-flow.js behind a new per-order leadFired guard. All asset cache tags bumped to ?v=20260730a.
automated_coverage_details: node --check all JS clean; HTML balanced index/thank-you/terms/photos; all asset refs on ?v=20260730a; zero user-facing VIP/870; zero em dashes in rendered text; no personal phone leak
browser_test_details: Playwright clean-browser desktop 1440x900 + mobile 390x844, all outbound stubbed: 0 console errors; single package 450/10-15s; Ran+Eden first, all 8 slides; 13 links alive; phone validation 80/80; pixel funnel each exactly once; Lead now per-order guarded; delivery #2 carries full identity; degraded path sends with unique subject; total Formspree per lifecycle = 2
known_flags: Dead 2-tier CSS remains in style.css (.tier-toggle-btn.vip, .pricing-card.pricing-vip at lines 686, 690, 1334, 1340, 1342, 2199); the classes appear nowhere in HTML or JS, cosmetic only. If Grow's redirect ever returns without paid=1, sd_pending_order is not cleared (order-flow.js:247) so the customer may see a 'complete your payment' banner for an order they already paid. The Lead pixel is now deliberately not fired when no order id can be resolved (cleared storage or private mode), consistent with Purchase, so Meta's Lead count is no longer a superset of paid orders and is expected to drop to a truer number. Two external actions remain on Eytan's side in the Grow dashboard: update the ₪450 payment page description from '7-10 שניות' to '10-15 שניות', and confirm the success redirect targets thank-you.html?paid=1&pkg=regular.
